prose: Adam Mastroianni asks whether AI will take all the jobs and lands on a narrow claim: AI may already be affecting hiring for the most exposed junior white-collar roles, but that attribution is contested and aggregate labor-market disruption has not yet appeared in the data. He sets that against public belief, with 71% of American adults expecting fewer jobs over 20 years, and Anthropic's CEO predicting a 10-20% unemployment spike in 1-5 years. Basis: the opening of a long essay.
highlights: Evidence supports only a narrow claim: possible effects on junior white-collar hiring.
Aggregate labor-market disruption not yet visible.
71% of Americans expect fewer jobs; Anthropic's CEO forecasts 10-20% unemployment.
